book.isekai_mahou.las_noches.page1:
RECORD OF THE THRONE

This palace was raised in the middle of nothing, where no sun was ever born.

So he made one.
book.isekai_mahou.las_noches.page2:
The dome holds a blue sky, clouds and a sun that gives no warmth. Outside, the crescent moon keeps still, watching.

A fake sky is the first step for whoever wants to take the place of the real one.
book.isekai_mahou.las_noches.page3:
The Espada receive numbers. The lower the number, the greater the spiritual pressure.

2 — the king who ages everything.
4 — the one who feels nothing.
6 — the one who only wants to fight.
book.isekai_mahou.las_noches.page4:
Above the dome there is a terrace where the fake sky ends and the true night begins.

They say that is where the Fourth shows his Segunda Etapa.
book.isekai_mahou.las_noches.page5:
The owner of this throne is not here.

Perhaps he never was.

Perhaps everything, from the very beginning, went exactly as he planned.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.barragan: Room 2 (west of the dome), the throne of bone and gold. His time rots everything — do not breathe near the Respira.
The old king of Hueco Mundo, who never accepted having a number.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.enter.hi: Cross the Gate (the old palace) to the King's Throne Room: a door in the north wall leads to the white corridor. The corridor also has a side exit to the desert. Follow it to the dome.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.enter.lo: Inside, it is day. A day someone manufactured.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.grimmjow: Room 6 (southeast of the dome, the room with the hole in the wall). Walk in and he appears. The room is protected during the fight.
The Sixth. A panther who only wants to know who is the strongest.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.intro: The King fell, but the Gate was only the beginning. To the north there is a white dome the size of a city... and inside it is DAY. Shall we see who lives under that fake sky?
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.lore: North of the Gate, a white corridor leads to Las Noches: a colossal dome with a blue sky painted inside, a sun that gives no warmth and a tower that pierces everything up to the true night. The numbered rooms house the Espada — and the throne at the center is empty.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.outro: The Fourth Espada crumbles to ash under the true moon, on top of the dome. Below, the fake sky stays blue, as if nothing happened. The throne is still empty. And that is the scariest part.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.throne.h: North of the dome, the tallest room. Read the record on the lectern before the empty throne.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.throne.l: A white throne, far too tall, for someone who never sits where others expect.
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.title: Las Noches
journal.isekai_mahou.las_noches.ulquiorr: Room 4 (east of the dome). When he shows the Segunda Etapa, the fight moves up to the dome terrace — the black seal at the base of the tower (sneak) also leads there.
The Fourth. Green eyes that do not cry, and one question: what is a heart?

message.isekai_mahou.las_noches.pressure: An ancient pressure, heavy as centuries, fills Room 2...
A growl echoes through Room 6. Spiritual pressure explodes!
The air in Room 4 turns cold and green. Someone opens their eyes.
message.isekai_mahou.las_noches.rebuildi: Las Noches will be rebuilt (while someone is in the Hollow World).
message.isekai_mahou.las_noches.reset: The Espada return to their rooms on the next visit.

title.isekai_mahou.las_noches.subtitle: Under the dome, a fake blue sky. Outside, a night that never ends.
